name: Tom Briggs
awards: RAAF Test Pilot of the Year
personal_statement: I fly. That is what I do. I have 3,280 hours across 34 aircraft types including experimental platforms that have never entered production. I have ejected once and landed a single-engine aircraft with total hydraulic failure twice. I know what calm looks like in a cockpit when everything is wrong. I want to bring that to space.
psychological_profile: Peak physical and operational readiness. Personal statement is brief and functional — reflects operational rather than reflective personality type. Low verbosity in written assessments does not reflect low depth; interview scores were among the highest in the cohort. Squadron commander Wing Commander Adam Ferris (+61-4-1123-4567) can speak to Briggs's performance under real emergency conditions if the panel wants a first-hand account. Recommend structured crew dynamics pairing.
